results.case: A1 in_sync: same base, no field diffs
A2 edits_only: same base, field diverged — normal draft, NOT a merge conflict
A3 base_moved_identical: stale anchor, content identical
A4 conflict: stale anchor + diverged field
A5 conflict via draft_only field (draft records what saved lacks)
A6 saved_only never counts toward conflict (overlay restore leaves it)
A7 unverifiable: draft side unreadable
A8 unverifiable: saved side missing (record never re-read)
A9 compare semantics: numeric tolerance, whitespace, key order
A10 diff rows carry per-side summaries (rows/tier/absent)
A11 rebase project: id + draft fields verbatim, isolated clone
A12 rebase writes through the real store: draft re-anchored, old base preserved in envelope
A13 rebase write honors CAS — a changed stored revision refuses
B1 none_needed: no receipt, no pending
B2 none_needed: receipt acknowledged by line snapshot
B3 resync_unacknowledged: receipt pending, no line marker
B4 resume_pending: durable line marker wins
B5 blocked_mismatch: receipt names another estimate
B6 blocked_unsupported: malformed receipt untouched
B7 blocked_no_estimate: standalone project (no receipt, no estimate)
B8 pending marker resumes even without a receipt on the project
C1 classified CAS conflict carries conflictDetected
C2 409-status error classifies as conflict + detected
C3 generic failure: no conflictDetected (dialog must not open)
C4 builder-sync failure → partial + pending, never conflictDetected
C5 stale-context save → superseded, no conflictDetected
D1 invalid: missing anchors → nothing read or written
D2 conflict: source moved under the acknowledged revision — no writes
D3 conflict: estimate unreadable → nothing written
D4 blocked: receipt names another estimate → recordSave never called
D5 already_synced: acknowledged receipt → recordSave never called
D6 resync_unacknowledged → recordSave called with line hint + record source + warning
D7 builderCalculation + savedProject overlay forwarded for descriptor parity
D8 resume_pending: expectedPendingKey forwarded; ack asserts line
D9 pending_key_changed → conflict, recordSave never called
D10 recordSave throws → failed, markers retained, error surfaced
D11 unacknowledged line after replay → pending (not claimed synced)
E1 real end-to-end: first sync mints parts; retry creates ZERO new parts
E2 forced re-sync while pending → converges on part_key, zero new creates on 2nd replay
E3 partial death mid-sync → retry completes, still no dup keys
E4 resume_pending replays the stored plan verbatim once, then already_synced
E5 resume with a foreign pending key → conflict, plan not replayed
